title: ConsoleChangeService
responsibility: Classifies what an install would overwrite, saves what it replaces and records each change with its before and after identity.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.constructor.host
inputs.description: Project root used as the base for file reads, writes, and replacement storage. The service joins supplied paths to it and does not validate the root.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.constructor.manifest
inputs.description: Manifest whose file entries classify ownership and whose change history is searched by state and restore. This service reads its files and changes arrays.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.state.path
inputs.description: Project file path whose current bytes and manifest entry determine the returned state. It is joined to the host root without path validation.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.state.contents
inputs.description: Text the caller wants at the path, or null when it wants the path removed. State compares the current bytes with this value but does not write it.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.replace.path
inputs.description: Project file path whose current bytes are saved before the requested write or removal. It is joined to the host root without path validation.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.replace.contents
inputs.description: Replacement text to write at the path, or null to remove it after saving its current bytes. A missing current file is saved as empty bytes.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.replace.change
inputs.description: The action and reason recorded for this change. The action must be one of the ConsoleChange action values; this method passes both fields into the returned record.

examples.reason: console install updated the existing file
console install removed an obsolete file

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.restore.path
inputs.description: Project file path whose most recent matching change should be restored. The service searches the manifest history from newest to oldest.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.remove.path
inputs.description: Project file path to remove under the host root. Missing paths are tolerated by the force option, while other filesystem failures can reject.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.write.path
inputs.description: Project file path to write under the host root. Its parent directories are created recursively before writing.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.write.contents
inputs.description: Text written to the path after its parent directories are created. Existing file contents are overwritten.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.entryFor.path
inputs.description: Project file path to record with its current content hash. If the file cannot be read, the entry is hashed as empty bytes.

inputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.entryFor.owner
inputs.description: Owner recorded for the file entry. The value is either harness or host.

outputs.name: replacedDirectory
outputs.description: Relative directory under the project root where replace stores the bytes it overwrites. Each saved copy is named with the SHA-256 hash of those bytes.

outputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.state
outputs.description: The resolved FileState describing whether writing the requested content is free, unchanged, kept by the host, or in conflict. It does not modify the file.

outputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.replace
outputs.description: The resolved ConsoleChange record for the write or removal. It includes the saved before identity and path, and after is null when contents is null.

examples.reason: console install updated the existing file
console install removed an obsolete file

outputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.restore
outputs.description: The resolved latest restoration record, or undefined when no matching change exists or its saved bytes cannot be read. A successful restore saves the current bytes in turn and writes back the bytes saved by the latest change.

outputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.remove
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after asking the filesystem to remove the path. The force option makes a missing path a successful no-op.

outputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.write
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after recursively creating the parent directories and writing the supplied text. Existing contents at the path are replaced.

outputs.name: ConsoleChangeService.entryFor
outputs.description: The resolved file entry containing the path, SHA-256 of its current bytes, and the supplied owner. An unreadable or missing file is represented using the SHA-256 of empty bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Filesystem operations that are not caught by the service reject with the underlying filesystem error when the operation fails.
